market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: Implied 1.1% probability severely underestimates the true tail risk of WTI crude dropping to $40 within 15 months. While a large move is not expected, historical volatility and recession scenarios give a ~5-10% physical chance. Given the wide gap, Yes is the cheaper side.
evidence_points: WTI has fallen below $40 three times since 2000 (2008-09, 2015-16, 2020) – a ~5-year cumulative exposure over 25 years.
Crude oil 1-year implied volatility is ~35%, making a drop to $40 from ~$70 a roughly 2-standard-deviation event, implying a ~5-10% probability under a risk-neutral measure.
The market only monitors daily settlement prices, not intraday touches, which slightly reduces probability but not to 1.1%.
sources_consulted: CME Crude Oil futures historical settlement data
